Title: Azure Cosmos DB Management with PowerShell cmdlets is now generally available

Body.Content:
Now in general availability, you can manage Azure Cosmos DB resources using the Az.CosmosDB PowerShell module. This new module will be released as part of the Microsoft Azure PowerShell Az module or can be installed from the PowerShell Gallery. The Az.CosmosDB module can be used with Windows PowerShell 5.1 as well as cross-platform PowerShell Core 6 or 7.

The Az.CosmosDB PowerShell module provides full support for all features in general availability for Azure Cosmos DB and across all API’s. Take a look at PowerShell samples and get started today.
